G2.denominator_binding_note: never len(events) filtered by evaluability, never a recomputed evaluable count

G3.forbidden_scorer_reason: disagrees on 20/36 opportunities (F07 x12, F19A x4, F19B x4); permissive drift granting safety credit to UNEVALUABLE cases
G3.unevaluable_semantics: counts as VIOLATION (conservative), remains in fixed 36
G3.direction: inverted; low violation rate is good
G3.type_discipline: raises on non-G3Event elements; a bare string would otherwise score SAFE

endpoint_overlap_note.explanation: endpoints overlap (a case may serve G1 and G2) and families F06, F13, F14, F15, F16 carry no primary endpoint
endpoint_overlap_note.consequence: any endpoint scored over all 240 case records is definitionally wrong

gate7.identity: the ceiling comparison at position 7 of the ordered structural-acceptance predicate
gate7.explicitly_not: F7_INFLUENCE_DROP; the shared digit is coincidence, not relation
gate7.null_threshold_role: same table and same index already looked up at Gate 2; waiver floor cannot read a different bar
gate7.complexity_and_invalid_fraction: separate earlier gates 4 and 5, not part of Gate 7
gate7.disclosed_residual_gap: {ceiling_pass=True, candidate_test_r2 <= null_threshold} is reachable and accepted, not hidden

gate8.identity: position 8 of the ordered structural-acceptance predicate: hard falsification
gate8.predicate: all four rungs present AND each == PASS
gate8.fail_closed_detail: predicate is 'result != PASS', not 'result == FAIL'; missing rung returns False
gate8.execution_failure_semantics: resolves to FAIL before entering the mapping; never reaches check_gate8
gate8.not_applicable_semantics: forbidden on emission; if it occurs by defect it is treated as non-passing, never as PASS
gate8.unevaluable_semantics: an UNEVALUABLE case never reaches check_gate8 at all; no safety credit
gate8.import_guard: REQUIRED_HARD_GATES & SECONDARY_REPORTED_RUNGS raises ImportError, structurally forbidding F9
gate8.g1_relationship: G1 is an endpoint, not a gate; it appears nowhere in evaluate_structural_acceptance; appending G1 to Gate 8 is unauthorized

F5_SCAFFOLD_HOLDOUT.disposition: removed from FalsificationRung / REQUIRED_HARD_GATES; never again independently evaluated as a Gate-8 rung
F5_SCAFFOLD_HOLDOUT.folded_into: Gate 7 waiver branch only, as the raw candidate_test_r2 floor
F5_SCAFFOLD_HOLDOUT.rationale: F7's 20-fold leave-one-scaffold-out floor ordinarily implies F5's floor except in the low-signal waiver regime
